results.title: Income test for JobSeeker Payment - Services Australia
results.description:
# Income test
## If you’re single and not a principal carer
| Your income per fortnight | Amount your payment reduces by |
|-|-|
| Up to $150 | $0 |

## Maximum income before your payment reduces to $0
### Maximum income per fortnight if you’re single
| Your situation | Maximum income before your payment reduces to $0 |
|-|-|
| Single, no children. | $1,557.17 |
| Single, assessed as having a [partial capacity to work](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/if-you-have-reduced-capacity-to-work?context=51411#partial) of less than 15 hours a week. | $1,667.34 |
| Single, principal carer of a dependent child younger than 16. | $2,399.50 |
| Single, with a dependent child younger than 16, but not the principal carer. | $1,655.67 |
